name: Memories of Magic
summary:
Memories of Magic, formerly known as EvilQuest, is a browser-based MMORPG set in a dark fantasy world, built around old-school combat, skilling, quests, and character progression. With a retro online RPG feel, Memories of Magic invites players to create an adventurer, explore the world directly from the browser, and build their account through classic MMO activities. The game leans into familiar scapelike systems such as skill training, monster hunting, rankings, and persistent progression while wrapping it in a darker, more ominous fantasy atmosphere.

In Memories of Magic, players can train skills, fight enemies, complete quests, compare progress through hiscores, and explore a growing online world alongside other adventurers. For players who enjoy browser MMOs focused on gradual progression, skilling, combat, and community-driven discovery, Memories of Magic offers a fresh dark-fantasy take on the classic scapelike formula.
